contract.idempotent_safety: Repeated unregister of an already removed listener does not raise an exception
contract.first_unregister: A registered listener is removed successfully and unregister returns true
contract.repeated_unregister: Unregister of a listener that is no longer registered returns false
contract.registry_stability: Repeated unregister does not recreate or corrupt the event registry
contract.post_unregister_emit: Events emitted after listener removal succeed even when no listeners remain
contract.delivery_isolation: A removed listener is never invoked by subsequent events
contract.permission_enforcement: Each unregister and emit operation requires the events permission
